{{Quote|Finally, the quiet and humble work-ethic of the Publictechnic JR series lifted them to a 55-54 upset win over the physically and intellectually superior Loronar B3NK lineup.|"Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand"|<ref name="Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|sports/1344_1.html|Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand}}</ref>}}
The '''JR series''' was a series of public works [[Droid/Legends|droids]] manufactured by [[Publitechnic]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="JR series droid">{{CSWECite|II|176|JR series droid}}</ref> known for its quiet and humble work ethic.<ref name="Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand" /> The [[JR-8 series maintenance droid|JR-8 janitorial droid]] was part of the JR series.<ref name="Kashyyyk in Flames">{{GamerCite|4|Kashyyyk in Flames}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The JR series was first identified in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 50|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #50'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]<ref name="Nuna-Ball League Looks to Expand" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[April 4]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN50 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6308795|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mavrick889|date=2002-04-04|time=3:16 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref>
